description:
EXECUTION task for card 820c9052 ("api test suite cannot collect"). That card has been armed twice (PM shifts #43, #44) and never executed, because the harness turns that received the work order have no shell/QA tools. This task exists so the probe runs in a chat whose profile CAN execute commands (qa).

## The one deliverable
The raw terminal output line(s) of the bounded probe below. Nothing else is acceptable as a result.

1. Bounded collect probe, 60 s cap, do NOT raise it:
   `cd api && timeout 60 .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/chat/test_single_response_per_chat.py --collect-only -q`
   Paste the LAST line verbatim + the exit code.

2. If it collected (test ids printed, exit 0), run the real thing:
   `cd api && timeout 120 .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/chat/test_single_response_per_chat.py -q`
   Paste the summary line (counts + time).

3. If it hangs again, name the blocking import — do not diagnose the whole graph:
   `api/.venv/bin/python -X importtime -c "import codx.junior.api.chat" 2>&1 | tail -30`
   then
   `api/.venv/bin/python -c "import faulthandler,signal; faulthandler.register(signal.SIGUSR1); import codx.junior.api.chat" & sleep 20; kill -USR1 %1`
   Paste the deepest `codx.junior.*` frame.

## Evidence conflict you must resolve by measuring, not by reasoning
Card 820c9052 measured 3 x timeouts / 0 tests on 2026-11-16, but shift #40 logged `pytest:api` 1308 passed / 3 failed at 17:12Z on 2026-11-18. Either is possible. Measure.

## Budget guard
Three consecutive 60 s timeouts = stop, paste the three outputs, report "hang reproducible" with the named suspect. Do not start a free-form diagnosis.

## On the result
- Collected + green -> report that the hang is no longer reproducible as of 2026-11-20 and that card 42bdacee (due today) can be unblocked.
- Collected + failing -> report the real counts; still a valid verdict, do not "fix" the test.
- Hang -> report the blocking import frame; a minimal import-time fix belongs to software_developer, not here.

## Forbidden
- Reporting "cannot reproduce" without the command and its output line.
- Editing production code in this task.
- Running the full suite (only the single file above).
